## What's Changed

### Features

- **agents**: harden keymaker directives with smith chain and infra track
- **agents**: add buildSmithSection prompt builder
- **background-agent**: unified parent notification with native wake

### Refactoring

- **tasks**: relocate enforcer helpers to task-session-scope
- **skills**: group skills into category subfolders

### Documentation

- drop README acknowledgment and remove stale port/migration plans
- refresh all docs to v1.2.1 codebase state
- **agents**: refresh all AGENTS.md files to match restructured codebase
- enforcer removal and unified parent notification

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #73 from klpanagi/docs/refresh-v1.2.1
- Fix formatting issues in README.md
- Merge pull request #72 from klpanagi/feat/keymaker-directives-harden
- Merge pull request #71 from klpanagi/docs/agents-md-refresh
- Merge origin/dev into docs/agents-md-refresh
- Merge pull request #70 from klpanagi/remove-enforcer-unified-bg-event
- Merge pull request #69 from klpanagi/restructure-readability
- Merge pull request #68 from klpanagi/feat/skills-tier1-reorg

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2

## What's Changed

### Features

- **category-skill-reminder**: pure nudge detector with 60s dedup wiring

### Bug Fixes

- **dcp**: bump generated schema URL to v3.2.0

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #67 from klpanagi/feat/wrong-tool-call-nudges
- Merge pull request #66 from klpanagi/fix/dcp-schema-3.2.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1

## What's Changed

### Features

- **skills**: canonical MCP tool names in skill templates
- **mcps**: startup-visible uvx notice via global notify sink
- **mcps**: lazy builtin registry with edge env reads
- **tools**: hide native subagent tool from model listing

### Bug Fixes

- **doctor**: reference 2.1.x release line in version messages
- **doctor**: accept context-mode 2.1.3 with version floor check
- **delegate-task**: stop reading streaming assistant messages as results
- **delegate-task**: return newest assistant with text in fetchSyncResult

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #65 from klpanagi/feat/context-mode-2-1-x-range
- Merge pull request #64 from klpanagi/feat/context-mode-2-1-3-lock
- Merge pull request #63 from klpanagi/fix/sync-delegation-read
- Merge pull request #62 from klpanagi/fix/niobe-sync-poll-orphaned-retrieval
- Merge pull request #61 from klpanagi/mcp-reliability-fixes
- Merge pull request #60 from klpanagi/feature/hide-native-subagent-tool

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

## What's Changed

### Features

- **background-task**: cancel native ses_ via interrupt; revive via re-prompt
- **background-task**: cancel native ses_ via interrupt

### Bug Fixes

- **background**: relink native ses_ to bg_ handles, gate completion on deliverable output
- **context-mode**: fail-open detection via config and discipline presence
- **doctor**: accept V1 and V2 context-mode keys with migration hint
- **delegation**: ses auto-resolve via disk handle plus task code-mode fail-closed guard
- **background-task**: return tail messages in background_output foreign and full-session paths
- **tests**: sync toast cleanup robust to mock.module cell-patch leaks
- **tests**: task-system gating warning robust to mock.module pollution

### Refactoring

- **agents**: migrate context-mode prompts to V2 tool names
- **context-mode**: migrate constants and routing to V2 tool names

### Documentation

- **subagent-block**: truthful message and allowlist docs

### Other Changes

- Merge pull request #59 from klpanagi/fix/bg-native-relink
- Merge pull request #58 from klpanagi/feature/context-mode-v2-migration
- Merge pull request #57 from klpanagi/feature/native-session-manageability
- Merge pull request #56 from klpanagi/fix/delegation-ses-resolve-codemode-guard
- Merge pull request #51 from klpanagi/fix/test-cleanup-36-failures
- Merge pull request #50 from klpanagi/chore/bump-bun-1-4-4

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/klpanagi/opencode-matrixx-2/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
